mostWorthwhile.text: The second pair of hands steadying the cold carrier and the shared silence made the discovery feel consequential and brought the solitary expedition to a human conclusion.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no action to take in this chapter; the brief ending was atmospheric, though I would have liked a little more of the receiving team's response.

surprise.text: The quiet reception surprised me: after the journey, nobody speaks when the limbs appear.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge as arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the laboratory learns from the body and its surrounding ice, though this ending also feels complete.
